This may be due to the structure of the survey that is visible in the codebook frequency list. `smoke_inside` has the two frequencies "logical skip" and "no valid responses" reported as `NA`s which is causing the `NA` count to increase. `breastfed` has the two frequencies "Not in universe" and "No valid response" both reporting as `NA`s which is also causing its `NA` count to increase.
